split_rule: within each T5 date, rank(anchor value, method='first') after sorting by (value, ticker); LOW = rank <= n/2. Ties resolve by ticker alphabetically so parquet row order can never be a hidden input.
exchangeability_assumption: Within the registered date x pre-liquidity x pre-volatility blocks, episode outcomes are exchangeable with respect to sequence membership under the null. This does NOT claim that ticker heterogeneity is controlled: one ticker contributes many episodes, and both sequence propensity and future MFE may be ticker-specific.
